mace.definition:
n. (trademark) a liquid that temporarily disables a person; prepared as an aerosol and sprayed in the face, it irritates the eyes and causes dizziness and immobilization
n. spice made from the dried fleshy covering of the nutmeg seed
n. a ceremonial staff carried as a symbol of office or authority
mace.translation:
n. 狼牙棒, 权标, 权杖, 执权标者
[医] 肉豆蔻衣

mace oil.translation:
[化] 肉豆蔻油
[医] [压制]肉豆蔻油

mace-bearers.translation: (mace-bearer 的复数) n. 执权杖者

macebearer.definition: n. an official who carries a mace of office

maced.translation: abbr. Macedonia （巴尔于半岛中南部的）马其顿地区; Macedonian 马其顿的; 马其顿人（的）; 马其顿语（的）

macedoine.definition: n mixed diced fruits or vegetables; hot or cold
macedoine.translation: 杂样水果冻, 混杂物

macedon.definition: n. the ancient kingdom of Philip II and Alexander the Great in the southeastern Balkans that is now divided among modern Macedonia and Greece and Bulgaria
macedon.translation: n. 马其顿王国（古代巴尔干半岛中部一奴隶制国家）

macedonia.definition: n. landlocked republic on the Balkan Peninsula; achieved independence from Yugoslavia in 1991
